reply.text: {"say":"Chest and back, balanced, with plenty of volume: three chest presses and flies, then vertical and horizontal pulls, finishing with straight-arm lat work.","title":"Chest & Back","days":[{"name":"Chest & Back","exercises":[{"key":"barbell-bench-press","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Shoulder blades pinned back and down."},{"key":"barbell-bent-over-row","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Flat back, pull to the lower ribs."},{"key":"dumbbell-incline-bench-press","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"30-degree incline, control the descent."},{"key":"cable-lat-pulldown","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Lead with the elbows, chest tall."},{"key":"machine-chest-press","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Full stretch, squeeze at the top."},{"key":"cable-seated-row","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pause at the chest each rep."},{"key":"cable-chest-fly","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Soft elbows, hug a barrel."},{"key":"straight-arm-cable-pulldown","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Arms nearly straight, feel the lats."}]}],"unmet":[]}
